name: hand_start_id
description: Primary key. Foreign key to hand_starts.hand_start_id. hand_actions is 1:1 with hand_starts, so the parent id is the primary key — there is no separate hand_action_id. Also the natural key for this table's replace-semantics writes.

name: hand_setup_id
description: Denormalized grandparent hand setup identifier. Equals hand_starts.hand_setup_id for this hand start; stored to give the assembly phase a direct join to hand_setups.

name: clip_id
description: Denormalized parent clip identifier. Equals hand_starts.clip_id for this hand start; stored to avoid joins on common queries.

name: video_id
description: Denormalized parent video identifier. Equals hand_starts.video_id for this hand start; stored to avoid joins on common queries.

name: hand_action_state
description: Observed action sequence, community cards, and outcome for the hand. Structure: {hand_start: {...verbatim copy of hand_starts.hand_start_state}, streets: [{street_name: string, street_timestamp: int|null, community_cards: [string], actions: [{action_order: int, seat_position_label: string, action_type: string, bet_amount: number|null}]}], winning_positions: [string]}. street_timestamp is an offset from the start of the source video in whole seconds, and is null for preflop (there is no card-reveal moment). The embedded hand_start is a snapshot taken at write time; reprocessing Phase 4 does not update it.

name: street_frame_gcs_paths
description: Full gs://... URIs to the frames extracted shortly after each postflop street's reveal timestamp, one per resolved street, ordered flop then turn then river. Empty for a hand that ended preflop. Never NULL — an empty repeated column is an empty array.

name: detected_at
description: Timestamp when this hand action row was written. Auto-populated on insert via DEFAULT.
